name: AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Associate

fee.note: USD list price; an eligible unused certification discount could reduce it to $75, but the benefit was not checked.

exam.format: 65 questions, 130 minutes, three-year validity; AWS recommends at least one year designing AWS solutions.

scope: Designing secure, resilient, high-performing and cost-optimized architectures on AWS.
ai_policy: Check the current assessment rules. AI-assisted study does not imply permission during the exam.
